services.name: Historic Stone Mountain
services.desc: Fly 6 minutes east of Atlanta to the city of Stone Mountain, where the vast monolith awaits at the gateway to Stone Mountain Park. Up to 2 People: $169 per person About See the Confederate Memorial Carving, etched into the rock’s side, which depicts Civil War generals Stonewall Jackson and Robert E. Lee, plus President Jefferson Davis. See the tiny little ant people below on the trail and the Summit Skyride cable car, both of which lead to the rock's peak. Spot the historic buildings dating back to 1793 which fill the park's Historic Square. There is no better way to experience Stone Flight to Georgia's Natural Wonder - $169 per person

quotes.text: Absolutely Recommended! This was by far an amazing experience! I went for my birthday with a few friends but this outting requires no special day. I absolutely recommend going on a night tour. The staff was extremely helpful and I was able to easily communicate with everyone before, during, and after our flight. Alex (our pilot) was very kind and knowledgeable. I felt extremely safe and happy that I found something new to enjoy in the city. There was also a cute restaurant near where we got to enjoyed music! I absolutely recommend Bi plane ride over Atlanta 10/10

Outstanding Experience! What an outstanding experience! Out pilot, Michael, was courteous, professional, and above all, safety minded. What a thrill it was to FEEL the air through the controls as I was piloting the Piper aircraft along the Atlanta skyline. Kudo's not only to Michael, and how he made the adventure superb, but also to the owner, who was communicative, and accommodating to our needs. We enjoyed the experience so-much, we are booking another flight!! Worth every penny. 5 Stars all the way!

Wonderful Experience! We had such a wonderful experience! Alex was great and very knowledgeable! The views were spectacular and loved being up there during the sunset! My husband and I received our ride as a Christmas gift and it was such a cool and unique gift. At first I was nervous, but after reading all the great reviews and meeting Alex I was way more comfortable! Definitely will be recommending to my friends and family members. Such a fun way to see the city an experience we won’t forget!! 10/10

quotes.author: Sasha Kemash
quotes.text: Biplane Rides Over Atlanta exceeded all expectations! Booking was smooth & communication was great from start to finish. The staff was friendly and professional, making us feel comfortable right away. The flight itself was breathtaking—stunning views of Atlanta, a smooth ride & an amazing pilot who pointed out landmarks and made the experience unforgettable. If you’re looking for an adventure, romantic date or bucket-list experience, this is it! Highly recommend and will definitely be back! ✈️🔥

Amazing Experience! First of all, Victor and Alex were both so great to deal with when it came to scheduling and overall communication. Alex was our pilot. He was very personable and funny. The ride itself was amazing. It was my cousin’s 50th birthday present and it was something that neither of us have ever experienced. I honestly can’t wait to do it again. The view was just beautiful. I would highly recommend booking if you are trying to decide!

quotes.author: Steve
quotes.text: We did this for my wife’s 72nd birthday. We had a great time , the city, lake and all the other sites we flew over were beautiful. We’ve lived here over 40 years and had never done this. We really have a beautiful city and surrounding area. Victorino was a pleasure to work with. We booked the sunset flight and we let Victorino make the decisions on where to fly, we couldn’t have asked for a better experience. We highly recommend it!!
